meta.name: Steel and concrete surface defect description corpus
meta.purpose: Natural-language descriptions used to (a) build the cached CLIP text embedding matrix T, and (b) support ablation (d), which compares hand-written prompts (M=0 context tokens) against learned context tokens.
meta.review_status: DRAFT - domain wording needs verification before use in DA2

tiers.bare: Class name alone. The zero-effort baseline prompt.
tiers.natural: Short natural phrasing an inspector would actually type.
tiers.material: Description grounded in the steel/rolling process context.
tiers.alias: Domain synonym or alternative industry term.

meta.usage_note: Held-out classes MUST NOT contribute descriptions to any training-time vocabulary in the openvocab protocol. Filter with scripts/build_prompts.py --protocol openvocab.
meta.namespacing_note: 'inclusion' exists in both NEU-DET and GC10-DET as the same concept in different imaging regimes. GC10's is keyed 'gc10_inclusion'; NEU-DET's stays 'inclusion' within its own label space. See src/tgfem/data.py.
